name: Bols Genever
base_ingredient: Malt wine from corn, wheat and rye (triple grain)
production: Malt wine distilled from equal parts wheat, rye and corn with a little malted barley
Malt wine comes off the pot still at ~47% ABV
Rested in oak min. 18 months (per The Gin is In reviewer)
history: 1664 | Lucas Bols first makes genever (per The Gin is In)
1820 | Bols Genever recipe documented (at least from)
palate: Base spirit leads, juniper in background
notes: ABV not found [cần kiểm tra]. Caraway/aniseed from Difford's (Bols genevers in general); ginger/hops/orange from reviewer; 22 botanicals per reviewer. Reviewer advises against G&T; suggests Improved Holland Gin Cocktail, genever punch, Negroni. Backlog year 1575 not confirmed by fetched sources.
